2609.31045.title: KuaFu: Compressing Long User Behavior into Understanding at Billion Scale
2609.31045.paper_summary: Conversational agents, generative recommenders, and personalized advertising all rest on one capability: understanding each user from raw behavior. Prevailing industrial practice is task-specific: for each task, a relevant subsequence is extracted from the full history and a dedicated model trained on it. In production it hits two bottlenecks. First, even after filtering, a single-task sequence stays extremely long: content-interest summarization reads several hundred items per user, tens of thousands of tokens once serialized as prompt text. Second, profiles are refreshed routinely: a billion users weekly, roughly 100K QPM in aggregate, which under a fixed GPU budget sets a hard throughput floor. Compression is therefore mandatory, yet truncation or coarse compression can silently distort the profile, introducing four hallucination types (fabrication, omission, date misattribution, broken logic) that, with no way to evaluate the compressed representation itself, surface only as diffuse degradation in downstream metrics. We present KuaFu, a unified behavior-compression layer whose minimal unit is one behavior item. A two-axis projector compresses each item into 2-4 tokens of width 128-256 (about 10x along the token axis, 20x along width; per-item cache 10 KB to 0.5 KB), with fidelity-oriented four-stage training and layered intermediate evaluation. Across four production profiling tasks it matches or exceeds uncompressed single-task production models on all five headline metrics, raises per-GPU throughput by 37%-350%, and saves 190 GPUs. On public benchmarks it nearly always beats prior compressors at the same compression ratio (up to +17.7 EM on out-of-domain MRQA); on RecBench, a 4B model surpasses its 8B counterpart by 1.90 points. KuaFu has run on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months, lifting overall GMV by 1.37%.
2609.31045.paper_summary_zh: 對話代理、生成推薦系統和個性化廣告都基於一項能力：從原始行為中理解每個用戶。當前的工業實踐是任務特定的：對於每個任務，從完整歷史中提取相關子序列並針對其訓練專用模型。在生產中，它面臨兩個瓶頸。首先，即使在過濾後，單任務序列仍然非常長：內容興趣總結每位用戶需要閱讀幾百項內容，序列化為提示文本後，令牌數量達到數萬。其次，個人資料會定期更新：每週有十億用戶，總體約為100K QPM，這在固定的GPU預算下設置了硬性吞吐量下限。因此，壓縮是必須的，但截斷或粗糙壓縮可能會無聲地扭曲個人資料，引入四種幻覺類型（虛構、遺漏、日期錯誤歸屬、邏輯錯誤），而且由於無法評估壓縮表示本身，這些問題僅在下游指標中表現為模糊的劣化。我們提出了KuaFu，一個統一的行為壓縮層，其最小單位是一個行為項目。一個雙軸投影器將每個項目壓縮為2-4個寬度為128-256的令牌（在令牌軸上約10倍，在寬度上約20倍；每項目緩存從10 KB壓縮到0.5 KB），並進行以保真度為導向的四階段訓練和分層中間評估。在四個生產配置任務中，它在所有五個主要指標上匹配或超越未壓縮的單任務生產模型，將每個GPU的吞吐量提高了37%-350%，並節省了190個GPU。在公共基準測試中，它幾乎總是超越先前的壓縮器，並且在相同的壓縮比下（在域外MRQA上最高提升17.7 EM）；在RecBench中，一個4B模型超過其8B對應模型1.90分。KuaFu已在騰訊廣告和推薦平台運行了十個月，整體GMV提升了1.37%。
